newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Retailer Second Chance to list in Singapore SESDAQ.
newsitem.headline: Retailer Second Chance to list in Singapore SESDAQ.

text.p: Jewellery and lifestyle fashion apparel retailer Second Chance Enterprises Ltd (SCE) said on Thursday it has received approval to list on the Stock Exchange of Singapore's second board, SESDAQ.
It gave no details in a statement announcing the approval, but some dealers said the initial public offer of about four million shares would be launched in early January.
Company officials were not available for comments.
The group pre-tax profits grew to S$4.6 million in 1996 from S$134,000 in 1992 while turnover grew to S$32 million from S$7.2 million, the statement said.
SCE now has eight retail outlets in Singapore nad Malaysia.
